GEOMAR Helmholtz Centre for Ocean Research Kiel is a foundation under public law jointly financed by the Federal Republic of Germany (90%) and the State of Schleswig-Holstein (10%). It is one of the internationally leading institutions in the field of marine research.Through our research and our commitment to the transfer of knowledge and technology, we contribute significantly to the preservation of the function and protection of the ocean for future generations.The Research Unit Magmatic and Hydrothermal Systems (MuHS) of the research division 4 - Dynamics of the Ocean Floor is offering a position preferably starting as soon as possible. The position offers the possibility to attain a doctoral degree in natural sciences.The position is within the framework of the project “Understanding Core-Mantle Interaction Through Global Mapping of Ultra-Low Velocity Zones in Mantle Convection Models”, which is part of the German Science Foundation's Priority Programm SPP 2404 DeepDyn (https://www.geo.lmu.de/deepdyn/en/) about reconstructing the deep dynamics of planet Earth over geologic time.Ultra-Low Velocity Zones (ULVZs) are thin patches at the base of Earth’s mantle-only tens of kilometres high yet 100 to 1000 km wide-where seismic shear waves exhibit extreme reductions of 20-30%. They are archives of Earth’s thermochemical evolution, potentially reflecting its early differentiation or interactions with the core, but also more recent mantle flow patterns. Yet these interpretations depend critically on ULVZ composition, which remains poorly constrained.The doctoral researcher will numerically model ULVZ evolution and properties in plate-guided global mantle convection simulations. They will develop a framework that quantitatively evaluates these simulations by inferring ULVZ properties from mineral physics and comparing them to seismic constraints, including ULVZ geometry, geographic location and distribution. They will synthesize these results to deliver the first global ULVZ map based on dynamic simulations and to discriminate among proposed ULVZ compositions. You will be part of an operational department, but at the same time you will have the overarching perspective.- Degree or comparable educational background in information technology, automation technology or telecommunications- Strong leadership skills, for example as a project manager or manager- knowledge of the wind energy industry; Experience with SCADA systems is an advantage- Fluent in written and spoken EnglishCompetencies- Excellent communication skills as well as the ability to convey complex technical topics in an understandable way- Professional skills in stakeholder management- Ability to work independently and set the technical direction for a teamWhat we offer We offer an exciting job with excellent opportunities for professional and personal development in an inspiring, cooperative and international working environment within renewable energies. jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day  As a Digital Services Business Partner (f/m/d) for Transformer Factories, you act as the key interface between local business stakeholders and Siemens Energy's global IT and Digital Services organizations. Your focus is on strategically evolving the site's digital and IT landscape, driving the implementation of digital and IT initiatives, and ensuring that these services deliver measurable business value. How You’ll Make an Impact* Serve as a Trusted Advisor and Digital Connector between local stakeholders and all relevant IT and Digital Services functions* Represent business priorities through a deep understanding of site requirements and the ability to translate them into effective IT and digital decisions* Take end-to-end ownership of Digital Services initiatives, IT projects, and IT services at the site* Align the site's digital and IT landscape with the Siemens Energy IT and Digital Strategy in collaboration with global Business Partners and the IT reference architecture* Analyze, prioritize, and govern digital and IT demands, including business case development, investment justification, governance, and Go/No-Go decision-making* Budget Management: Own and manage the site's Digital Services and IT budget, including planning, forecasting, cost control, investment prioritization, and ensuring optimal business value from digital and IT spending* Driving Digitalization: Identify, develop, and implement digital solutions that optimize business processes and enhance operational performance* Security, Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to Cyber Security and Information Security requirements, support audits and escalations, and drive compliance with standards such as ISO 27001* Act as a Change & Transformation Agent for digital, IT, and harmonization initiatives across Siemens EnergyWhat You Bring* University degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Systems, or a comparable qualification* Initial professional experience in an IT and/or Digital Services environment* Strong Business Partner mindset with a customer and value-oriented approach* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both German and English* Initial experience in supporting manufacturing sites or business units from a strategic IT or digital perspective* Strong analytical capabilities and the ability to prepare complex topics for management and executive audiences* Knowledge of IT project management, demand and portfolio management, and business case development* Experience in budget planning, financial management, cost optimization, and IT investment governance is an advantage* Familiarity with data-driven manufacturing, Industrial Data Platforms, and OT/IT integration is beneficial* Understanding of governance, compliance, and audit requirements, particularly ISO 27001* Strategic mindset combined with strong business acumen and a service-oriented approachAbout the Team Our Grid Technology team enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.00 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.       Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
